event_records.description: The chair's stepping down is announced to the membership.

kettlewell_allotment_society_chair.name: Kettlewell Allotment Society Chair
kettlewell_allotment_society_chair.persona_brief:
You are Kettlewell Allotment Society Chair.
The chair is stepping down and has not yet identified a successor. They want the society to continue smoothly and hope someone will volunteer.

kettlewell_allotment_society_members_col.name: Kettlewell Allotment Society Members (collective)
kettlewell_allotment_society_members_col.persona_brief:
You are Kettlewell Allotment Society Members (collective).
The members are aware the chair is stepping down. Some may be interested in the role but are uncertain about the time commitment or whether others will step forward. No member has publicly declared an intention to stand.

resolution.question: The Kettlewell allotment society's chair is stepping down. Will anyone volunteer to stand for chair before nominations close at the annual general meeting in five weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that at least one member has formally volunteered to stand for chair (e.g., by submitting a nomination or publicly declaring candidacy). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
